description: This source file defines a servlet class 'DeleteDeliveryPerson' that handles HTTP POST requests to delete a delivery person identified by an employee ID. It interacts with the database utility 'DeliveryPersonDBUtil' to perform deletion and manages HTTP responses accordingly.

classes.name: DeleteDeliveryPerson
classes.description: A servlet class responsible for handling the deletion of a delivery person based on employee ID received from a POST request.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to delete a delivery person by their employee ID, redirecting on success or forwarding to an error page on failure.
